title.zh: 卷四十六 本紀第四十六: 順帝九
title.raw: 卷四十六 本紀第四十六: 順帝九 Volume 46 Annals 46: Shundi 9

sentences.zh: 順帝九

translations.literal: Shundi 9
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 9

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月癸丑朔，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, spring, first month, guichou new moon; an edict pardoned all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on the new moon of guichou in the first month of spring, an edict pardoned all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 命中書參知政事七十往諭孛羅帖木兒罷兵還鎮，復遣使往諭察罕帖木兒，亦令罷兵。

translations.literal: The Secretariat was ordered to send associate chief minister Qishi to instruct Bolad Temür to cease warfare and return to his commandery; envoys were again dispatched to instruct Chaghan Temür likewise to cease warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat ordered associate chief minister Qishi to tell Bolad Temür to stand down and return to his post, and sent envoys to Chaghan Temür with the same order.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒縱兵掠冀寧等處，察罕帖木兒以兵拒之，故有是命。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür had loosed troops to plunder Jining and other places; Chaghan Temür resisted with troops — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür had let his troops raid Jining and other districts while Chaghan Temür fought them off, which prompted this command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太陰犯歲星。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the moon transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the moon transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，河南賊犯杞縣，察罕帖木兒討平之。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Henan bandits attacked Qi County; Chaghan Temür suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, rebels in Henan attacked Qi County, and Chaghan Temür defeated and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，李思齊進兵平伏羌縣等處。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Li Siqi advanced troops and pacified Fuxian County and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Li Siqi advanced and pacified Fuxian County and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，石州大風拔木，六畜俱鳴，民所持槍，忽生火焰，抹之即無，搖之即有。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, in Shizhou a great wind uprooted trees; all livestock cried out; spears held by the people suddenly produced flames — wiped away they vanished, shaken they reappeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, a violent wind in Shizhou uprooted trees and set every kind of livestock crying; spears in the hands of commoners suddenly burst into flame, vanishing when rubbed out and flaring again when shaken.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未朔，填星退犯太微垣。

translations.literal: Second month, guiwei new moon; Saturn retreated and transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of guiwei, Saturn retreated and transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲申，同僉樞密院事叠裏帖木兒復永平、灤州等處。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, joint associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Dieli Temür recovered Yongping, Luanzhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, joint associate commissioner Dieli Temür recovered Yongping, Luanzhou, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 己丑，察罕帖木兒駐兵霍州，攻孛羅帖木兒。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Chaghan Temür stationed troops at Huozhou and attacked Bolad Temür.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Chaghan Temür encamped at Huozhou and attacked Bolad Temür.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 是月，江南行臺侍御史八撒剌不花殺廣東廉訪使完者篤、副使李思誠、僉事叠麥赤，以兵自衛，據廣州。

translations.literal: That month, Jiangnan Branch Censorate attendant censor Basarlabuhua killed Guangdong surveillance commissioner Wanzhedu, vice commissioner Li Sicheng, and commissioner Diemaichi, took troops for self-defense, and seized Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangnan branch censorate attendant censor Basarlabuhua killed Guangdong surveillance commissioner Wanzhedu, vice commissioner Li Sicheng, and commissioner Diemaichi, mustered troops for his own protection, and seized Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 時八撒剌不花以廉訪使久居廣東，專恣自用，詔乃以完者篤等為廉訪司官，而除八撒剌不花侍御史。

translations.literal: At the time Basarlabuhua had long resided in Guangdong as surveillance commissioner, acting arbitrarily on his own authority; an edict then appointed Wanzhedu and others as surveillance officials and transferred Basarlabuhua to attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: Basarlabuhua had long served in Guangdong as surveillance commissioner and ruled as he pleased; an edict therefore appointed Wanzhedu and others to the surveillance commission and transferred Basarlabuhua to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 八撒剌不花不受命，怒完者篤等代己，即誣以罪，盡殺之，惟廉訪使董鑰哀請得免。

translations.literal: Basarlabuhua did not accept the appointment; enraged that Wanzhedu and others had replaced him, he immediately framed them with crimes and killed them all; only surveillance commissioner Dong Yue, through tearful pleading, was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Basarlabuhua refused the transfer; furious that Wanzhedu and the others had replaced him, he framed them on false charges and had them all killed, sparing only surveillance commissioner Dong Yue, who was spared after desperate pleas.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: Third month, bingchen day; the moon transgressed the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，察罕帖木兒調兵討永城縣，又駐兵宿州，擒賊將梁綿住。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Chaghan Temür mobilized troops to attack Yongcheng County; he also stationed troops at Suzhou and captured the bandit general Liang Mianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Chaghan Temür mobilized troops against Yongcheng County, then encamped at Suzhou and captured the rebel general Liang Mianzhu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，熒惑犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Mars transgressed the Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Mars transgressed the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 是月，張士誠海運糧一十一萬石至京師。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Shicheng transported by sea one hundred ten thousand shi of grain to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Shicheng shipped one hundred ten thousand shi of grain by sea to the capital.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒罷兵還，遣脫列伯等引兵據延安，以謀入陜。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür ceased warfare and returned; he dispatched Tolui-Buqa and others to lead troops to seize Yan'an, plotting to enter Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür stood down and withdrew, then sent Tolui-Buqa and others to occupy Yan'an with an eye to advancing into Shaan.

sentences.zh: 張良弼出南山義谷，駐藍田，受節制於察罕帖木兒。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangbi came out through Yigu in the southern hills of Zhongnan, stationed at Lantian, and was placed under the command of Chaghan Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangbi marched out through Yigu in the southern Zhongnan hills, encamped at Lantian, and placed himself under Chaghan Temür's command.

sentences.zh: 良弼又陰結陜西行省平章政事定住，聽丞相帖裏帖木兒調遣，營於鹿臺。

translations.literal: Liangbi also secretly allied with Shaanxi Branch Secretariat chief minister Dingzhu, obeyed the deployments of chief minister Tieli Temür, and encamped at Lutai.
translations.idiomatic: Liangbi also secretly aligned with Shaanxi branch secretariat chief minister Dingzhu, accepted orders from chief minister Tieli Temür, and encamped at Lutai.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinsi new moon; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the new moon of xinsi in the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，以張良弼為陜西行省參知政事。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Liangbi was made associate chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Liangbi was appointed associate chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒遣其子副詹事擴廓帖木兒貢糧至京師，皇太子親與定約，遂不復疑。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür sent his son, vice director of the Household of the Heir Apparent Köke Temür, to present tribute grain at the capital; the heir apparent personally concluded a pact with him, and suspicion ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür sent his son Köke Temür, vice director of the heir apparent's household, to deliver tribute grain to the capital; the heir apparent met him in person to seal an agreement, and doubts about his loyalty were laid to rest.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，四川明玉珍陷嘉定等路，李思齊遣兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guichou day; Sichuan's Ming Yuzhen captured Jiading Circuit and other places; Li Siqi dispatched troops and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guichou day, Ming Yuzhen of Sichuan captured Jiading circuit and other districts; Li Siqi sent troops and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the moon transgressed the Room asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the moon transgressed the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Venus transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Venus transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，熒惑犯太白。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Mars transgressed Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Mars transgressed Venus.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，察罕帖木兒以兵侵孛羅帖木兒所守之地。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Chaghan Temür led troops to invade the territories Bolad Temür was defending.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Chaghan Temür invaded the territories held by Bolad Temür.

sentences.zh: 是月，李思齊受李武、崔德等降。

translations.literal: That month, Li Siqi accepted the surrender of Li Wu, Cui De, and others.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Siqi accepted the surrender of Li Wu, Cui De, and their followers.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，熒惑、歲星、太白聚於翼宿。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yiwei day; Mars, Jupiter, and Venus gathered in the Wings asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yiwei day, Mars, Jupiter, and Venus converged in the Wings asterism.

sentences.zh: 丙申，察罕帖木兒總兵討山東，發晉軍，下井陘，出邯鄲，過磁、相、懷、衛，逾白馬津，發其軍之在汴梁者繼之，水陸並進。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Chaghan Temür took overall command to campaign in Shandong; he mobilized Jin troops, descended Jingxing Pass, emerged at Handan, passed Ci, Xiang, Huai, and Wei, crossed the White Horse Ford, and sent the troops he had at Bianliang to follow; land and water forces advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Chaghan Temür took overall command of the Shandong campaign, mobilized Jin troops down Jingxing Pass and out through Handan, marched through Ci, Xiang, Huai, and Wei, crossed the White Horse Ford, and brought up the forces he had stationed at Bianliang by land and water together.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯雲雨。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the moon transgressed Clouds and Rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the moon transgressed the Clouds and Rain asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，察罕帖木兒平東昌。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinhai day; Chaghan Temür pacified Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month on the xinhai day, Chaghan Temür pacified Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，沂州西北有赤氣蔽天如血。

translations.literal: On jisi day, northwest of Yizhou a crimson vapor veiled the sky like blood.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, a blood-red vapor in the northwest of Yizhou covered the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，察罕帖木兒進兵復冠州。

translations.literal: That month, Chaghan Temür advanced troops and recovered Guanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chaghan Temür advanced and recovered Guanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，大同路北方夜有赤氣蔽天，移時方散。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yiyou day; north of Datong Circuit, at night a crimson vapor veiled the sky and only after some time did it disperse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yiyou day, a crimson vapor north of Datong circuit covered the night sky and did not disperse for some time.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以福建行省平章政事普化帖木兒為江南行臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Fujian Branch Secretariat chief minister Buhua Temür was made censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Fujian branch secretariat chief minister Buhua Temür was appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大明兵取江州路。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Ming forces captured Jiangzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Ming forces captured Jiangzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 時偽漢陳友諒據江州為都，至是退都武昌。

translations.literal: At the time the false Han ruler Chen Youliang held Jiangzhou as his capital; on this occasion he withdrew his capital to Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youliang of the false Han had made Jiangzhou his capital; he now withdrew his court to Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 是月，察罕帖木兒遣其子擴廓帖木兒、閻思孝等，會關保、虎林赤等，將兵由東河造浮橋以濟，賊以二萬餘眾奪之，關保、虎林赤且戰且渡，拔長清，討東平，東平偽丞相田豐遣崔世英等出戰，大破之。

translations.literal: That month, Chaghan Temür sent his son Köke Temür, Yan Sixiao, and others to join Guan Bao, Qutuγan Qadaγan, and others in leading troops; they built a pontoon bridge on the eastern river to cross; the bandits with more than twenty thousand men seized it; Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan fought while crossing, took Changqing, and campaigned against Dongping; Dongping's false chief minister Tian Feng sent Cui Shiying and others to give battle and was utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chaghan Temür sent his son Köke Temür and Yan Sixiao to join Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan, who built a pontoon bridge on the eastern river to cross; more than twenty thousand rebels tried to seize it, but Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan fought their way across, captured Changqing, and marched on Dongping, where the false chief minister Tian Feng sent Cui Shiying and others into battle and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 乃遣使招諭田豐，豐降，東平平，令豐為前鋒，從大軍東討。

translations.literal: Envoys were then sent to summon and instruct Tian Feng; Feng surrendered, Dongping was pacified, and Feng was ordered to serve as vanguard in the main army's eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: They then sent envoys to win Tian Feng over; he surrendered, Dongping was pacified, and he was ordered to serve as vanguard in the army's eastward advance.

sentences.zh: 棣州俞寶降，東平王士誠、東昌楊誠等皆降，魯地悉定。

translations.literal: Dizhou's Yu Bao surrendered; Dongping's Wang Shicheng, Dongchang's Yang Cheng, and others all surrendered; the Lu region was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bao of Dizhou surrendered, as did Wang Shicheng of Dongping, Yang Cheng of Dongchang, and others, and the Lu region was fully secured.

sentences.zh: 進兵濟南，劉珪降，遂圍益都。

translations.literal: The army advanced on Jinan; Liu Gui surrendered, and they then besieged Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced on Jinan; Liu Gui surrendered, and they then laid siege to Yidu.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，陽翟王阿魯輝帖木兒伏誅。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuwu day; Prince of Yangdi Aruγui Temür was executed by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuwu day, Prince of Yangdi Aruγui Temür was executed.

sentences.zh: 阿魯輝帖木兒以宗親，見天下盜賊並起，遂乘間隙，肆為異圖，詔少保、知樞密院事老章率諸軍討之。

translations.literal: Aruγui Temür, as a member of the imperial clan, seeing bandits rise everywhere under Heaven, then seized the interval to pursue contrary designs; an edict ordered junior guardian and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Lao Zhang to lead the armies to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Aruγui Temür, a kinsman of the throne, saw rebels rising everywhere and seized the moment to plot rebellion; an edict ordered junior guardian and bureau director Lao Zhang to lead the armies against him.

sentences.zh: 老章遂敗其眾，尋為部將同知太常禮儀院事脫歡所擒，送闕下，詔誅之。

translations.literal: Lao Zhang then defeated his forces; before long he was captured by his subordinate, associate director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Toγan, sent to the capital, and an edict ordered his execution.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Zhang defeated his forces, and soon his subordinate Toγan, associate director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, captured him and sent him to the capital, where an edict ordered his execution.

sentences.zh: 於是詔加老章太傅、和寧王，以阿魯輝帖木兒之弟忽都帖木兒襲封陽翟王。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict added to Lao Zhang the titles grand preceptor and Prince of Hening, and Aruγui Temür's younger brother Qutuγ Temür was enfeoffed to succeed as Prince of Yangdi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then made Lao Zhang grand preceptor and Prince of Hening, and enfeoffed Aruγui Temür's younger brother Qutuγ Temür as the new Prince of Yangdi.

sentences.zh: 宗王囊加、玉樞虎兒吐華與脫歡悉議加封。

translations.literal: Princes Nangγa, Yusγur Qutuγtuγ, and Toγan all deliberated on adding honors.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Nangγa, Yusγur Qutuγtuγ, and Toγan all joined in recommending additional honors.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，四川賊兵陷東川郡縣，李思齊調兵擊之。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Sichuan bandit troops captured the prefectures and counties of eastern Sichuan; Li Siqi mobilized troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, rebel troops in Sichuan overran the eastern prefectures and counties, and Li Siqi mobilized forces to strike back.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命孛羅帖木兒於保定以東，河間以南，從便屯種。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Bolad Temür was ordered east of Baoding and south of Hejian to garrison and farm as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Bolad Temür was ordered to establish garrison farms east of Baoding and south of Hejian as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 是月，命兵部尚書徹徹不花、侍郎韓祺征海運糧於張士誠。

translations.literal: That month, Minister of War Cheche-Buqa and vice minister Han Qi were ordered to levy seaborne tribute grain from Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Minister of War Cheche-Buqa and vice minister Han Qi were ordered to collect seaborne tribute grain from Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 大明取建昌、饒州二路。

translations.literal: The Ming captured Jianchang and Raozhou circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces captured Jianchang and Raozhou circuits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，絳州有赤氣見北方如火。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guisi day; in Jiangzhou a crimson vapor appeared in the north like fire.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month on the guisi day, a fire-like crimson vapor appeared in the north over Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以察罕帖木兒為中書平章政事，兼知河南、山東等處行樞密院事、陜西行御史臺中丞。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür was made Secretariat chief minister, concurrently director of the Henan and Shandong Branch Bureau of Military Affairs and censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür was appointed Secretariat chief minister, with concurrent charge of the Henan and Shandong branch bureau of military affairs and as censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒調參知政事陳秉直、劉珪等守御河南。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür deployed associate chief ministers Chen Bingzhi, Liu Gui, and others to defend Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür assigned associate chief ministers Chen Bingzhi, Liu Gui, and others to defend Henan.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申朔，溫州樂清縣雷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wushen new moon; Leqing County in Wenzhou was struck by thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon of wushen, thunder struck Leqing County in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the moon transgressed the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the moon transgressed the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，黃河自平陸三門磧下至孟津，五百餘里皆清，凡七日。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the Yellow River from Pinglu's Sanmen Gorge down to Mengjin — more than five hundred li — was entirely clear for seven days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the Yellow River from Sanmen Gorge at Pinglu down to Mengjin ran clear for more than five hundred li, and remained so for seven days.

sentences.zh: 命秘書少監程徐祀之。

translations.literal: Secretariat vice director Cheng Xu was ordered to perform sacrifices for it.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director of the Secretariat Cheng Xu was ordered to offer sacrifices for the omen.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the moon transgressed the Root asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the moon transgressed the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 是月，察罕帖木兒、李思齊遣兵圍鹿臺，攻張良弼，詔和解之，俾各還信地，兵乃解。

translations.literal: That month, Chaghan Temür and Li Siqi dispatched troops to besiege Lutai and attack Zhang Liangbi; an edict ordered reconciliation, that each return to his entrusted territory, and the armies then dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chaghan Temür and Li Siqi besieged Lutai and attacked Zhang Liangbi; an edict ordered them to make peace and return each to his own territory, and the armies withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師大饑，屯田成，收糧四十萬石。

translations.literal: That year the capital suffered great famine; garrison farming succeeded and forty myriad shi of grain were harvested.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital suffered severe famine, but garrison farming succeeded and yielded four hundred thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 賜司農丞胡秉彜尚尊、金幣，以旌其功。

translations.literal: Director of Agriculture Hu Bingyi was granted ceremonial vessels and gold and silks to mark his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Bingyi, director of agriculture, was rewarded with ceremonial vessels, gold, and silks in recognition of his achievement.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月戊申朔，太白犯建星。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, spring, first month, wushen new moon; Venus transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on the new moon of wushen in the first month of spring, Venus transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔李思齊討四川，張良弼平襄漢。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, an edict ordered Li Siqi to campaign in Sichuan and Zhang Liangbi to pacify Xiang and Han.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, an edict ordered Li Siqi to campaign in Sichuan and Zhang Liangbi to pacify Xiang and Han.

sentences.zh: 時兩軍不和，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time the two armies were at odds — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies were then at odds, which prompted this order.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，填星退犯左執法。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Saturn retreated and transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Saturn retreated and transgressed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大明取江西龍興諸路。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the Ming captured the Longxing circuits of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Ming forces captured the Longxing circuits of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 時江西諸路皆陳友諒所據。

translations.literal: At the time the circuits of Jiangxi were all held by Chen Youliang.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi circuits had all been held by Chen Youliang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔以太尉完者帖木兒為陜西行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, an edict made grand marshal Wanzhe Temür left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, an edict appointed grand marshal Wanzhe Temür left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 仍命察罕帖木兒屯種於陜西。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür was still ordered to garrison and farm in Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür was also ordered to establish garrison farms in Shaan.

sentences.zh: 申諭李思齊、張良弼等各以兵自效。

translations.literal: Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and others were expressly instructed each to devote his troops to service.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and the others were expressly told to commit their troops to the dynasty's service.

sentences.zh: 以也先不花為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Yeshan-Buqa was made right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yeshan-Buqa was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑朔，盜殺陜西行省右丞塔不歹。

translations.literal: Second month, dingchou new moon; bandits killed Shaanxi Branch Secretariat right vice minister Tabudai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of dingchou, rebels killed Shaanxi branch secretariat right vice minister Tabudai.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Venus transgressed the Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Venus transgressed the Encampment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，彗星見於危宿，光芒長丈餘，色青白。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, a comet appeared in the Rooftop asterism; its tail was more than a zhang long, its color bluish white.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, a comet appeared in the Rooftop asterism with a tail more than a zhang long and a bluish-white glow.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，彗星犯離宮西星，至二月終，光芒長二丈餘。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the comet transgressed the western star of the Lateral Palace; by the end of the second month its tail was more than two zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the comet transgressed the western star of the Lateral Palace, and by the end of the second month its tail had grown to more than two zhang.

sentences.zh: 是月，知樞密院事禿堅帖木兒奉詔諭李思齊討四川。

translations.literal: That month, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Tuγ Temür, bearing an edict, instructed Li Siqi to campaign in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, bureau director Tuγ Temür was sent with an edict instructing Li Siqi to campaign in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時思齊退保鳳翔，使至，思齊進兵益門鎮；

translations.literal: At the time Siqi had withdrawn to defend Fengxiang; when the envoy arrived, Siqi advanced troops to Yimen Town;
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi had withdrawn to Fengxiang; when the envoy arrived, he advanced to Yimen Town;

sentences.zh: 使還，思齊復歸鳳翔。

translations.literal: when the envoy returned, Siqi again withdrew to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: but when the envoy departed, he returned to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，彗星不見星形，惟有白氣，形曲竟天，西指掃大角。

translations.literal: Third month, wushen day; the comet showed no star-form, only a white vapor, curved in shape spanning the sky, pointing west and sweeping past Great Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wushen day, the comet no longer showed a stellar body, only a white vapor arcing across the sky and sweeping west past Great Horn.

sentences.zh: 壬子，彗星行過太陽前，惟有星形，無芒，在昴宿，至戊午始滅。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the comet passed before the sun; only a star-form remained, without a tail, in the Hairy Head asterism; it did not vanish until wuwu day.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the comet passed before the sun as a star without a tail in the Hairy Head asterism, and did not disappear until the wuwu day.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，四川明玉珍陷雲南省治，屯金馬山，陜西行省參知政事車力帖木兒等擊敗之，擒明玉珍弟明二。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Sichuan's Ming Yuzhen captured the seat of Yunnan Province and encamped at Golden Horse Mountain; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate chief minister Cheli Temür and others defeated him and captured Ming Yuzhen's younger brother Ming Er.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Ming Yuzhen of Sichuan seized the Yunnan provincial seat and encamped at Golden Horse Mountain; Cheli Temür, associate chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, and others defeated him and captured Ming Yuzhen's younger brother Ming Er.

sentences.zh: 己未，御史大夫老的沙辭職，不許。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, censor-in-chief Laodisha resigned his office; the resignation was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, censor-in-chief Laodisha submitted his resignation, which was refused.

sentences.zh: 是月，命孛羅帖木兒為中書平章政事，位第一，加太尉。

translations.literal: That month, Bolad Temür was ordered to be Secretariat chief minister, ranked first, with the added title grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bolad Temür was appointed Secretariat chief minister in the first rank and given the additional title of grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 張良弼受節制於孛羅帖木兒。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangbi was placed under the command of Bolad Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangbi was placed under Bolad Temür's command.

sentences.zh: 李思齊遣兵攻良弼，至於武功，良弼以伏兵大破之。

translations.literal: Li Siqi dispatched troops to attack Liangbi; reaching Wugong, Liangbi with ambush troops inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi sent troops against Liangbi, but at Wugong Liangbi routed them with an ambush.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，長星見，其形如練，長數十丈，在虛、危之間，後四十餘日乃滅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingzi new moon; a long comet appeared, its form like silk floss, tens of zhang in length, between the Emptiness and Rooftop asterisms; more than forty days later it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the new moon of bingzi in the fourth month, a long comet appeared like a skein of silk, tens of zhang long between the Emptiness and Rooftop asterisms, and did not vanish for more than forty days.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，熒惑離太陽三十九度，不見，當出不出。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Mars was thirty-nine degrees from the sun and invisible — it should have emerged but did not.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Mars stood thirty-nine degrees from the sun and was invisible, failing to emerge when it should have.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔諸王、駙馬、御史臺各衙門，不許占匿人民不當差役。

translations.literal: On jichou day, an edict to princes, imperial sons-in-law, and the various offices of the Censorate forbade seizing and concealing the people to evade corvée obligations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, an edict forbade princes, imperial sons-in-law, and censorate offices from seizing and hiding commoners to keep them from corvée service.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賊新橋張陷安州，孛羅帖木兒來請援兵。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the bandit Zhang of Xinqiao captured Anzhou; Bolad Temür came to request relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the rebel Zhang of Xinqiao captured Anzhou, and Bolad Temür came to request reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 是月，紹興路大疫。

translations.literal: That month, Shaoxing Circuit suffered a great epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shaoxing circuit was ravaged by a severe epidemic.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳朔，泉州賽甫丁據福州路，福建行省平章政事燕只不花擊敗之，余眾航海還據泉州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi new moon; Quanzhou's Saif al-Din seized Fuzhou Circuit; Fujian Branch Secretariat chief minister Yenje-Buqa defeated him, and the remainder took to the sea and returned to hold Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of yisi, Saif al-Din of Quanzhou seized Fuzhou circuit; Fujian branch secretariat chief minister Yenje-Buqa defeated him, and the survivors fled by sea back to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 福建行省參知政事陳有定復汀州路。

translations.literal: Fujian Branch Secretariat associate chief minister Chen Youding recovered Tingzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian branch secretariat associate chief minister Chen Youding recovered Tingzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書參知政事陳祖仁上章，乞罷修上都宮闕。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Secretariat associate chief minister Chen Zuren submitted a memorial requesting cessation of repairs to the palaces at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Secretariat associate chief minister Chen Zuren submitted a memorial asking that work on the palaces at Shangdu be halted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 辛未，明玉珍據成都，自稱隴蜀王，遣偽將楊尚書守重慶，分兵寇龍州、青州，犯興元、鞏昌等路。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Ming Yuzhen held Chengdu, styled himself King of Long-Shu, sent his false general Yang the Minister of Works to defend Chongqing, and divided troops to raid Longzhou and Qingzhou and invade Xingyuan, Gongchang, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Ming Yuzhen seized Chengdu and styled himself King of Long-Shu; he sent his general Yang the Minister of Works to hold Chongqing and divided his forces to raid Longzhou and Qingzhou and strike Xingyuan, Gongchang, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 是月，張士誠海運糧一十三萬石至京師。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Shicheng transported by sea one hundred thirty thousand shi of grain to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Shicheng shipped one hundred thirty thousand shi of grain by sea to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，彗星見紫微垣，光芒長尺餘，東南指，西南行。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinsi day; a comet appeared in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; its tail was more than a chi long, pointing southeast and moving southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinsi day, a comet appeared in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure with a tail more than a chi long, pointing southeast and moving southwest.

sentences.zh: 戊子，彗星光芒掃上宰。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the comet's tail swept the Chief Minister star.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the comet's tail swept past the Chief Minister star.

sentences.zh: 田豐及王士誠刺殺察罕帖木兒，遂走入益都城，眾乃推察罕帖木兒之子擴廓帖木兒為總兵官，復圍益都。

translations.literal: Tian Feng and Wang Shicheng assassinated Chaghan Temür, then fled into Yidu city; the troops thereupon acclaimed Chaghan Temür's son Köke Temür as overall military commander and again besieged Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Feng and Wang Shicheng assassinated Chaghan Temür and fled into Yidu; the army then acclaimed Chaghan Temür's son Köke Temür as commander-in-chief and renewed the siege of Yidu.

sentences.zh: 詔贈察罕帖木兒推誠定遠宣忠亮節功臣、開府儀同三司、上柱國、河南行省左丞相，追封忠襄王，謚獻武，食邑沈丘縣；

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted Chaghan Temür the title Meritous Minister of Sincere Devotion, Settling the Far, Proclaiming Loyalty, and Bright Integrity, made him grand master of splendid happiness with privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies and pillar of state, Henan Branch Secretariat left chief minister, enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Loyal Submission with posthumous name Xianwu and fief in Shenqiu County;
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously honored Chaghan Temür as Meritous Minister of Sincere Devotion, Settling the Far, Proclaiming Loyalty, and Bright Integrity, appointed him grand master of splendid happiness with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies and pillar of state and left chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, and enfeoffed him posthumously as Prince of Loyal Submission with the temple name Xianwu and a fief in Shenqiu County;

sentences.zh: 令河南、山東等處立廟，長吏歲時致祭。

translations.literal: Henan, Shandong, and other places were ordered to erect temples, and chief officials were to offer seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Temples were ordered erected in Henan, Shandong, and other regions, with local chiefs to offer seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 其父司徒阿都溫賜良田二百頃；

translations.literal: His father, director of education Aduγun, was granted two hundred qing of fertile fields;
translations.idiomatic: His father, director of education Aduγun, was granted two hundred qing of fertile farmland;

sentences.zh: 其子擴廓帖木兒授光祿大夫、中書平章政事，兼知河南山東等處行樞密院事、同知詹事院事，一應軍馬，並聽節制。

translations.literal: His son Köke Temür was appointed grand master for splendid happiness and Secretariat chief minister, concurrently director of the Henan and Shandong Branch Bureau of Military Affairs and vice director of the Household of the Heir Apparent; all military forces were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: His son Köke Temür was appointed grand master for splendid happiness and Secretariat chief minister, with concurrent charge of the Henan and Shandong branch bureau of military affairs and as vice director of the heir apparent's household; all armies were placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 仍詔諭其將士曰：「凡爾將佐，久為察罕帖木兒從事，惟恩與義，實同骨肉，視彼逆黨，不共戴天，當力圖報復，以伸大義。

translations.literal: An edict still instructed his generals and soldiers, saying: "All you commanders have long served under Chaghan Temür; in grace and righteousness you are truly as flesh and bone; toward those rebel factions you cannot live under the same sky — you must strive to take revenge and fulfill great righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: An edict also told his officers and men: "You have long served Chaghan Temür; in loyalty and duty you are as close as kin. Those rebels are your mortal enemies — strive to avenge him and uphold righteousness."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，益都賊兵出戰，擴廓帖木兒生擒六百餘人，斬首八百餘級。

translations.literal: " On jihai day, Yidu's rebel troops came out to give battle; Köke Temür captured alive more than six hundred men and took more than eight hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, rebel troops sallied from Yidu; Köke Temür took more than six hundred prisoners and more than eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，彗星滅跡。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yimao day; the comet vanished without trace.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month on the yimao day, the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，熒惑見西方，須臾，成白氣如長蛇，光炯有文，橫亙中天，移時乃滅。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Mars appeared in the west; in a moment it became a white vapor like a long serpent, its light bright with markings, spanning the mid-heaven, and only after some time did it vanish.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Mars appeared in the west, then swiftly became a white vapor like a long serpent, bright and patterned, stretching across the mid-heaven before vanishing after some time.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決范陽縣，漂民居。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Fanyang County and swept away dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Fanyang County and swept away people's homes.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，擴廓帖木兒言：「孛羅帖木兒、張良弼據延安，掠黃河上下，欲東渡以奪晉寧，乞賜詔諭。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jihai day; Köke Temür said: "Bolad Temür and Zhang Liangbi hold Yan'an, plunder up and down the Yellow River, and wish to cross east to seize Jinning — I beg that an edict of instruction be granted."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jihai day, Köke Temür reported: "Bolad Temür and Zhang Liangbi hold Yan'an, raid along the Yellow River, and plan to cross east to seize Jinning — I beg that an edict be sent to restrain them."

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: " On guisi day, the moon transgressed the Net asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the moon transgressed the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯朔，劉福通以兵援田豐，至火星埠，擴廓帖木兒遣關保邀擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guimao new moon; Liu Futong led troops to relieve Tian Feng, reaching Huoxing Ford; Köke Temür sent Guan Bao to intercept and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of guimao, Liu Futong marched to relieve Tian Feng and reached Huoxing Ford; Köke Temür sent Guan Bao to intercept him and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以山北廉訪司權置於惠州。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the Shanbei Surveillance Commission was provisionally established at Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the Shanbei surveillance commission was provisionally established at Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太白犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Venus transgressed the Neck asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Venus transgressed the Neck asterism.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the moon transgressed the Dipper asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the moon transgressed the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，歲星犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，熒惑犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Mars transgressed the Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Mars transgressed the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以也速為遼陽行省左丞相，依前總兵，撫安迤東郡縣。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Yesu was made left chief minister of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, still in overall command of troops, to pacify the prefectures and counties of eastern Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Yesu was appointed left chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, retaining overall military command to pacify the eastern Liaodong prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 己巳，有流星如酒杯，色青白，光明燭地。

translations.literal: On jisi day, a meteor like a wine cup appeared, bluish white in color, its brilliance illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, a meteor the size of a wine cup appeared, bluish white and bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯鬼宿積屍氣。

translations.literal: Mars transgressed the corpse-gas of the Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: Mars transgressed the corpse-gas of the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申朔，江西行省平章朵列不花移檄討八撒剌不花。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renshen new moon; Jiangxi Branch Secretariat chief minister Dore-Buqa issued a proclamation to campaign against Basarlabuhua.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the new moon of renshen in the tenth month, Jiangxi branch secretariat chief minister Dore-Buqa issued a proclamation to campaign against Basarlabuhua.

sentences.zh: 時朵列不花分省廣州，適邵宗愚陷廣州，執八撒剌不花，殺之。

translations.literal: At the time Dore-Buqa had branched the secretariat at Guangzhou; just then Shao Zong'en captured Guangzhou, seized Basarlabuhua, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Dore-Buqa had been administering Guangzhou when Shao Zong'en captured the city, seized Basarlabuhua, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，孛羅帖木兒南侵擴廓帖木兒所守之地，遂據真定路。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Bolad Temür invaded south into the territories Köke Temür was defending and then seized Zhending Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Bolad Temür invaded the territories held by Köke Temür and seized Zhending circuit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯牛宿。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon transgressed the Ox asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the moon transgressed the Ox asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，辰星犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Mercury transgressed the Neck asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Mercury transgressed the Neck asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Net asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，擴廓帖木兒復益都，田豐等伏誅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yisi day; Köke Temür recovered Yidu; Tian Feng and others were executed by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yisi day, Köke Temür recovered Yidu and Tian Feng and his followers were executed.

sentences.zh: 自擴廓帖木兒既襲父職，身率將士，誓必復仇，人心亦思自奮，圍城益急。

translations.literal: From the time Köke Temür had succeeded to his father's post, he personally led generals and soldiers, swearing he must take revenge; men's hearts also wished to exert themselves, and the siege grew ever tighter.
translations.idiomatic: Once Köke Temür had succeeded his father, he led the troops in person, swearing to avenge him; morale surged and the siege tightened.

sentences.zh: 賊悉力拒守，乃以壯士穴地通道而入，遂克之，盡誅其黨，取田豐、王士誠之心以祭察罕帖木兒。

translations.literal: The rebels defended with all their strength; then stalwart men tunneled underground to enter, and the city was taken; all their faction were executed; the hearts of Tian Feng and Wang Shicheng were taken to sacrifice to Chaghan Temür.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels defended with all their strength until stalwart men tunneled in and took the city; their entire faction was executed, and the hearts of Tian Feng and Wang Shicheng were offered in sacrifice to Chaghan Temür.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，擴廓帖木兒遣關保復莒州，山東悉平。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Köke Temür sent Guan Bao to recover Juzhou; Shandong was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Köke Temür sent Guan Bao to recover Juzhou, and Shandong was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔授擴廓帖木兒太尉、銀青榮祿大夫、中書平章政事、知樞密院事、太子詹事，便宜行事，襲總其父兵；

translations.literal: On gengshen day, an edict appointed Köke Temür grand marshal, grand master for splendid happiness bearing the silver seal, Secretariat chief minister, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, with discretionary authority, succeeding to overall command of his father's armies;
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict appointed Köke Temür grand marshal, grand master for splendid happiness bearing the silver seal, Secretariat chief minister, director of the bureau of military affairs, and director of the heir apparent's household, with discretionary authority and command of his father's armies;

sentences.zh: 將校、士卒，論賞有差；

translations.literal: officers and soldiers were rewarded according to rank;
translations.idiomatic: officers and soldiers were rewarded according to merit;

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒父阿魯溫進封汝陽王，察罕帖木兒改贈宣忠興運弘仁效節功臣，追封潁川王，改謚忠襄。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür's father Aruγun was advanced to Prince of Ruyang; Chaghan Temür's posthumous grant was changed to Meritous Minister of Proclaiming Loyalty, Raising Fortune, Broad Benevolence, and Devoted Service, enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Yingchuan with posthumous name changed to Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür's father Aruγun was advanced to Prince of Ruyang; Chaghan Temür's posthumous honors were raised to Meritous Minister of Proclaiming Loyalty, Raising Fortune, Broad Benevolence, and Devoted Service, and he was enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Yingchuan with the temple name Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，四川賊兵陷清州。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Sichuan bandit troops captured Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, rebel troops in Sichuan captured Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，太陰犯角宿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day; the moon transgressed the Horn asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renchen day, the moon transgressed the Horn asterism.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以中書平章政事佛家奴為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Secretariat chief minister Foqianu was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Secretariat chief minister Foqianu was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，樞密副使李士瞻上疏極言時政，凡二十條：一曰悔己過，以詔天下；

translations.literal: That year, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Shizhan submitted a memorial speaking bluntly on current policy, twenty items in all: first, repent one's faults and proclaim this to all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: That year, bureau vice director Li Shizhan submitted a blunt memorial on current policy in twenty points: first, repent the ruler's faults and proclaim this to the realm;

sentences.zh: 二曰罷造作，以快人心；

translations.literal: second, cease construction projects to ease people's hearts;
translations.idiomatic: second, halt palace construction to ease popular resentment;

sentences.zh: 三曰禦經筵，以講聖學；

translations.literal: third, attend the classics lecture to expound sagely learning;
translations.idiomatic: third, attend the classics lecture and study the sages;

sentences.zh: 四曰延老成，以詢治道；

translations.literal: fourth, summon the experienced and aged to inquire into the way of governance;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, summon experienced elders to advise on governance;

sentences.zh: 五曰去姑息，以振乾剛；

translations.literal: fifth, remove indulgent leniency to rouse the firmness of Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, end excessive leniency to restore imperial firmness;

sentences.zh: 六曰開言路，以求得失；

translations.literal: sixth, open the path of speech to seek what is gained and lost;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, open channels of criticism to learn what succeeds and fails;

sentences.zh: 七曰明賞罰，以厲百司；

translations.literal: seventh, clarify rewards and punishments to encourage the hundred offices;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, make rewards and punishments clear to discipline the bureaucracy;

sentences.zh: 八曰公選舉，以息奔競；

translations.literal: eighth, make selections public and fair to quell frantic competition;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, make official selection fair and public to end frantic office-seeking;

sentences.zh: 九曰察近幸，以杜奸弊；

translations.literal: ninth, scrutinize those near and favored to block corruption;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, scrutinize court favorites to stop corruption;

sentences.zh: 十曰嚴宿衛，以備非常；

translations.literal: tenth, tighten palace guards to guard against the unexpected;
translations.idiomatic: tenth, tighten palace security against emergencies;

sentences.zh: 十一曰省佛事，以節浮費；

translations.literal: eleventh, reduce Buddhist rites to economize on wasteful expenditure;
translations.idiomatic: eleventh, cut back Buddhist ceremonies to curb wasteful spending;

sentences.zh: 十二曰絕濫賞，以足國用；

translations.literal: twelfth, end indiscriminate rewards to fill state revenue;
translations.idiomatic: twelfth, end indiscriminate rewards to shore up state finances;

sentences.zh: 十三曰罷各宮屯種，俾有司經理；

translations.literal: thirteenth, abolish garrison farming at the various palaces and let the regular offices manage it;
translations.idiomatic: thirteenth, end palace garrison farming and leave it to regular officials;

sentences.zh: 十四曰減常歲計置，為諸宮用度；

translations.literal: fourteenth, reduce the regular annual appropriations set aside for the various palaces' expenses;
translations.idiomatic: fourteenth, reduce the regular annual appropriations for palace expenses;

sentences.zh: 十五曰招集散亡，以實八衛之兵；

translations.literal: fifteenth, summon and gather the scattered and lost to fill the armies of the Eight Guards;
translations.idiomatic: fifteenth, recruit scattered troops to fill the Eight Guards;

sentences.zh: 十六曰廣給牛具，以備屯田之用；

translations.literal: sixteenth, broadly supply oxen and implements to prepare for garrison farming;
translations.idiomatic: sixteenth, supply more oxen and tools for garrison farming;

sentences.zh: 十七曰獎勵守令，以勸農務本；

translations.literal: seventeenth, reward prefects and magistrates to encourage agriculture and root the state in the fundamental;
translations.idiomatic: seventeenth, reward local officials to encourage agriculture as the foundation of the state;

sentences.zh: 十八曰開誠布公，以禮待藩鎮；

translations.literal: eighteenth, open sincerity and show fairness, treating frontier commanderies with ritual propriety;
translations.idiomatic: eighteenth, deal openly and fairly with regional commanders;

sentences.zh: 十九曰分遣大將，急保山東；

translations.literal: nineteenth, dispatch great generals separately to urgently secure Shandong;
translations.idiomatic: nineteenth, dispatch major generals at once to secure Shandong;

sentences.zh: 二十曰依唐廣寧故事，分道進取。

translations.literal: twentieth, follow the Tang precedent of Guangning and advance by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: twentieth, follow the Tang Guangning precedent and advance on separate routes.

sentences.zh: 先是薊國公脫火赤上言乞罷三宮造作，帝為減軍匠之半，還隸宿衛，而造作如故，故士瞻疏首及之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Duke of Ji Toγaqu had memorialized requesting cessation of construction at the three palaces; the emperor reduced military artisans by half and returned them to palace guard service, yet construction continued as before — hence Shizhan's memorial began with this.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Duke of Ji Toγaqu had asked to halt construction at the three palaces; the emperor halved the military artisans and returned them to palace guard service, but construction continued — which is why Shizhan began his memorial with this point.

sentences.zh: 皇太子嘗坐清寧殿，分布長席，列坐西番、高麗諸僧。

translations.literal: The heir apparent once sat in Qingning Hall, spreading long mats and seating in rows the monks of Tibet, Korea, and other lands.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent once sat in Qingning Hall with long mats laid out for Tibetan, Korean, and other monks seated in rows.

sentences.zh: 皇太子曰：「李好文先生教我儒書多年，尚不省其義。

translations.literal: The heir apparent said: "Master Li Haowen has taught me Confucian books for many years, yet I still do not grasp their meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent said: "Master Li Haowen has taught me the Confucian classics for years, yet I still do not understand them.

sentences.zh: 今聽佛法，一夜即能曉焉。

translations.literal: Now, hearing Buddhist teaching, in a single night I can comprehend it."
translations.idiomatic: Yet listening to Buddhist teaching, I can grasp it in a single night."

sentences.zh: 」於是頗崇尚佛學。

translations.literal: Thereupon he came rather to esteem Buddhist learning.
translations.idiomatic: He thereafter came to favor Buddhist learning.

sentences.zh: 帝以讒廢高麗王伯顏帖木兒，立塔思帖木兒為王。

translations.literal: The emperor, on slander, deposed the King of Korea Bayan Temür and installed Tash Temür as king.
translations.idiomatic: On slander, the emperor deposed the King of Korea Bayan Temür and installed Tash Temür in his place.

sentences.zh: 國人上書言舊王不當廢、新王不當立之故。

translations.literal: The people of the kingdom submitted memorials stating why the old king should not have been deposed and the new king should not have been installed.
translations.idiomatic: Koreans submitted memorials explaining why the old king should not have been deposed and the new king should not have been enthroned.

sentences.zh: 初，皇后奇氏宗族在高麗，恃寵驕橫，伯顏帖木兒屢戒飭不悛，高麗王遂盡殺奇氏族。

translations.literal: Initially, Empress Gi's clansmen in Korea, relying on favor, were arrogant and overbearing; Bayan Temür repeatedly admonished them without reform, and the King of Korea then killed the entire Gi clan.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Gi's kinsmen in Korea had grown arrogant on imperial favor; Bayan Temür repeatedly warned them without effect, and the King of Korea eventually exterminated the entire Gi clan.

sentences.zh: 皇后謂太子曰：「爾年已長，何不為我報仇！

translations.literal: The empress said to the heir apparent: "You are already grown — why do you not avenge me!"
translations.idiomatic: The empress told the heir apparent: "You are grown now — why will you not avenge me!"

sentences.zh: 」時高麗王昆弟有留京師者，乃議立塔思帖木兒為王，而以奇族子三寶奴為元子，以將作同知崔帖木兒為丞相，以兵萬人送之國，至鴨綠江，為高麗兵所敗，僅余十七騎還京師。

translations.literal: At the time a younger brother of the King of Korea was detained at the capital; they then deliberated installing Tash Temür as king, making a son of the Gi clan, Sanbaonu, heir apparent, and the associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings Cui Temür chief minister, and sent ten thousand troops to escort him home; at the Yalu River they were defeated by Korean troops, and only seventeen horsemen returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A younger brother of the King of Korea was then detained at the capital; they planned to install Tash Temür as king, make Gi clansman Sanbaonu heir apparent, and Cui Temür, associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, chief minister, and sent ten thousand troops to escort him home; at the Yalu they were defeated by Korean forces, and only seventeen horsemen returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔加封唐撫州刺史南庭王危全諷為南庭忠烈靈惠王。

translations.literal: An edict added enfeoffment to Tang's prefect of Fuzhou, Prince of Nanting Wei Quanfeng, as Prince of Loyal Martyrdom and Spiritual Grace of Nanting.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced Tang prefect of Fuzhou and Prince of Nanting Wei Quanfeng to Prince of Loyal Martyrdom and Spiritual Grace of Nanting.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月壬寅朔，四川明玉珍僭稱皇帝，建國號曰大夏，紀元曰天統。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, spring, first month, renyin new moon; Sichuan's Ming Yuzhen presumptuously styled himself emperor, established the state name Great Xia, and the reign title Heavenly Unity.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on the new moon of renyin in the first month of spring, Ming Yuzhen of Sichuan declared himself emperor, founded the state of Great Xia, and adopted the reign title Heavenly Unity.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大寧陷。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Daning fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Daning fell.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，歲星犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Second month, wuxu day; Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚子，亦如之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the same occurred.

sentences.zh: 是月，擴廓帖木兒自益都領兵還河南，留鎖住以兵守益都，以山東州縣立屯田萬戶府。

translations.literal: That month, Köke Temür led troops from Yidu back to Henan, left Suochu with troops to guard Yidu, and established garrison-farming commanderies of ten thousand households for Shandong's prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month Köke Temür led his army from Yidu back to Henan, left Suochu to garrison Yidu, and established garrison-farming offices for Shandong's prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑朔，彗星見東方，經月乃滅。

translations.literal: Third month, xinchou new moon; a comet appeared in the east and only after a month did it vanish.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of xinchou, a comet appeared in the east and remained for a month before vanishing.

sentences.zh: 詔中書平章政事愛不花分省冀寧，擴廓帖木兒遣兵據之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Secretariat chief minister Aibuqa to branch the secretariat at Jining; Köke Temür dispatched troops to seize it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Secretariat chief minister Aibuqa to administer Jining, but Köke Temür sent troops to seize it.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁未，親試進士六十二人，賜寶寶、楊牴進士及第，余出身有差。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the emperor personally examined sixty-two jinshi candidates; Bao Bao and Yang Di were granted jinshi with honors; the rest received degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the emperor personally examined sixty-two jinshi candidates; Bao Bao and Yang Di passed with highest honors, and the rest received degrees of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Root asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大同路夜有赤氣亙天，中侵北斗。

translations.literal: On renxu day, at night in Datong Circuit a crimson vapor spanned the sky, its center encroaching on the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, a crimson vapor at night spanned the sky over Datong circuit and encroached on the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 是月，立廣西行中書省，以廉訪使也兒吉尼為平章政事。

translations.literal: That month, the Guangxi Branch Secretariat was established, with surveillance commissioner Yerzhinike as chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Guangxi branch secretariat was established, with surveillance commissioner Yerzhinike as chief minister.

sentences.zh: 時南方郡縣多陷沒，惟也兒吉尼獨保廣西者十五年。

translations.literal: At the time southern prefectures and counties mostly fell; only Yerzhinike alone held Guangxi for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Most southern prefectures and counties had fallen, yet Yerzhinike alone held Guangxi for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 立膠東行中書省及行樞密院，總制東方事。

translations.literal: The Jiaodong Branch Secretariat and Branch Bureau of Military Affairs were established to oversee eastern affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaodong branch secretariat and branch bureau of military affairs were established to oversee affairs in the east.

sentences.zh: 以袁宏為參知政事。

translations.literal: Yuan Hong was made associate chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hong was appointed associate chief minister.

sentences.zh: 是春，關先生余黨復自高麗還寇上都，孛羅帖木兒擊降之。

translations.literal: That spring, the remnant followers of Master Guan again returned from Korea to raid Shangdu; Bolad Temür attacked and accepted their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the remnant followers of Master Guan returned from Korea to raid Shangdu, and Bolad Temür attacked and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinchou day; Mars transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month on the xinchou day, Mars transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒、李思齊互相交兵。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür and Li Siqi attacked one another in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür and Li Siqi fought one another.

sentences.zh: 庚申，歲星犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 是月，擴廓帖木兒遣貊高等以兵擊張良弼。

translations.literal: That month, Köke Temür sent Mo Gao and others with troops to attack Zhang Liangbi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Köke Temür sent Mo Gao and others to attack Zhang Liangbi.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳朔，張士誠海運糧十三萬石至京師。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jisi new moon; Zhang Shicheng transported by sea one hundred thirty thousand shi of grain to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of jisi, Zhang Shicheng shipped one hundred thirty thousand shi of grain by sea to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲午，亦如之。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the same occurred.

sentences.zh: 乙未，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Mars transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Mars transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 是月，爪哇遣使淡濛加加殿進金表，貢方物。

translations.literal: That month, Java sent an envoy, Tamenggagadian, to present a golden memorial and tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That month Java sent the envoy Tamenggagadian to present a golden memorial and tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌朔，孛羅帖木兒遣方脫脫迎匡福於彰德，擴廓帖木兒遣兵追之，敗還。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuxu new moon; Bolad Temür sent Fang Toto to welcome Kuang Fu at Zhangde; Köke Temür dispatched troops in pursuit and defeated them, and they returned in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of wuxu, Bolad Temür sent Fang Toto to welcome Kuang Fu at Zhangde; Köke Temür pursued with troops and drove them back in defeat.

sentences.zh: 匡福遂據保定路。

translations.literal: Kuang Fu thereupon seized Baoding Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang Fu then seized Baoding circuit.

sentences.zh: 己亥，擴廓帖木兒部將歹驢等駐兵藍田、七盤，李思齊攻圍興平，遂據盩厔。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Köke Temür's lieutenant general Dai Lü and others stationed troops at Lantian and Qipan; Li Siqi besieged Xingping and then seized Meixian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Köke Temür's generals Dai Lü and others encamped at Lantian and Qipan while Li Siqi besieged Xingping and then took Meixian.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒時奉詔進討襄漢，而歹驢阻道於前，思齊踵襲於後，乃請催督擴廓帖木兒東出潼關，道路既通，即便南討。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür at the time was ordered by edict to advance and campaign against Xiang and Han; but Dai Lü blocked the road in front while Siqi pursued and attacked from behind; he therefore requested that Köke Temür be urged and supervised to march east out of Tong Pass; once the roads were open, he would at once campaign southward.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür had been ordered to advance against Xiang and Han, but Dai Lü blocked his path while Li Siqi attacked from the rear, so he asked the court to press Köke Temür to march east through Tong Pass; once the route was clear, he would drive south at once.

sentences.zh: 戊申，孛羅帖木兒遣竹貞等入陜西，據其省治。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Bolad Temür dispatched Zhuzhen and others to enter Shaanxi and seize the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Bolad Temür sent Zhuzhen and others into Shaanxi and seized the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 時陜西行省右丞答失鐵木兒與行臺有隙，且恐陜西為擴廓帖木兒所據，陰結於孛羅帖木兒，請竹貞入城，劫御史大夫完者帖木兒及監察御史張可遵等印。

translations.literal: At the time Dash Temür, right vice director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, had a rift with the regional inspection commission; moreover, fearing that Shaanxi would be seized by Köke Temür, he secretly allied with Bolad Temür, invited Zhuzhen into the city, and seized the seals of censor-in-chief Wanzhe Temür and investigating censor Zhang Kezun and others.
translations.idiomatic: Dash Temür, right vice director of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, was at odds with the regional inspection commission and, fearing that Köke Temür would take Shaanxi, secretly joined Bolad Temür, let Zhuzhen into the city, and seized the seals of censor-in-chief Wanzhe Temür, investigating censor Zhang Kezun, and others.

sentences.zh: 其後屢使召完者帖木兒，貞拘留不遣。

translations.literal: Thereafter messengers were repeatedly sent to summon Wanzhe Temür, but Zhen detained him and would not release him.
translations.idiomatic: After that the court repeatedly summoned Wanzhe Temür, but Zhuzhen detained him and refused to let him go.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒遣部將貊高與李思齊合兵攻之，竹貞出降，遂從擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: Köke Temür dispatched his lieutenant general Mo Gao to join forces with Li Siqi in attacking them; Zhuzhen surrendered and then followed Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temür sent Mo Gao to join Li Siqi in attacking Zhuzhen; Zhuzhen surrendered and went over to Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，星隕於濟南龍山，入地五尺。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, a star fell at Long Mountain in Jinan and penetrated the earth five feet.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, a meteor fell at Long Mountain in Jinan and buried itself five feet into the ground.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔授江南下第及後期舉人為路、府、州儒學教授。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, an edict appointed failed candidates and late-arriving examination graduates from Jiangnan as professors in the Confucian schools of Circuits, prefectures, and subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, an edict appointed failed candidates and late examination graduates from Jiangnan as professors in the Confucian schools of circuits, prefectures, and subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Venus transgressed the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Venus transgressed the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，絳州有白虹二道，沖斗牛間。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, in Jiangzhou there were two white rainbows, piercing through the space between the Dipper and Ox asterisms.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, two white rainbows appeared over Jiangzhou, stretching through the space between the Dipper and Ox asterisms.

sentences.zh: 庚申，平陽路有白氣三道，一貫北極，一貫北斗，一貫天漢，至夜分乃滅。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, in Pingyang Circuit there were three streaks of white vapor, one running through the Celestial Pole, one through the Northern Dipper, and one through the Celestial River; they did not vanish until midnight.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, three streaks of white vapor appeared over Pingyang circuit, one crossing the Celestial Pole, one the Northern Dipper, and one the Celestial River, and they did not fade until midnight.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白晝見，夜犯井宿。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Venus was visible in daylight; at night it transgressed the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Venus was visible by day; that night it transgressed the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰朔，京師大雹，傷禾稼。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, wuchen new moon; in the capital there was a great hailstorm that damaged grain and crops.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the new moon of wuchen in the seventh month, a great hailstorm struck the capital and damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以馬良為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Ma Liang was made associate chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Ma Liang was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 有星墜於慶元路西北，聲如雷，光芒數十丈，久之乃滅。

translations.literal: A star fell in the northwest of Qingyuan Circuit; the sound was like thunder, its radiance tens of zhang; only after a long time did it vanish.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor fell in northwestern Qingyuan circuit with a thunderous roar and a blaze tens of zhang long before it finally faded.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，倭人寇蓬州，守將劉暹擊敗之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou new moon; Japanese raiders attacked Pengzhou; the defending commander Liu Xian defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of dingyou, Japanese raiders attacked Pengzhou, and the defending commander Liu Xian routed them.

sentences.zh: 自十八年以來，倭人連寇瀕海郡縣，至是海隅遂安。

translations.literal: Since the eighteenth year, Japanese raiders had repeatedly attacked coastal prefectures and counties; from this time the seacoast was settled in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Since the eighteenth year Japanese raiders had repeatedly struck the coastal prefectures and counties; from this point the seacoast was finally secure.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，擴廓帖木兒遣兵侵孛羅帖木兒所守之境。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Köke Temür dispatched troops to invade the territories Bolad Temür was defending.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Köke Temür sent troops to invade the territories held by Bolad Temür.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Venus transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Venus transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Venus transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Venus transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Net asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 沂州有赤氣亙天，中有白色如蛇形，徐徐西行，至夜分乃滅。

translations.literal: In Yizhou a crimson vapor spanned the heavens; within it was a whiteness shaped like a serpent, which slowly moved westward and did not vanish until midnight.
translations.idiomatic: A crimson vapor spanned the sky over Yizhou, with a serpent-shaped white form inside that slowly drifted west until midnight before it faded.

sentences.zh: 戊午，孛羅帖木兒言：「擴廓帖木兒踵襲父惡，有不臣之罪，乞賜處置。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Bolad Temür said: "Köke Temür has followed in his father's evil; he has committed the crime of disloyalty to the throne; I beg that disposition be granted."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Bolad Temür said: "Köke Temür has followed his father's wicked example and committed the crime of disloyalty; I ask that he be punished."

sentences.zh: 」己未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: " On jiwei day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Venus transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Venus transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Venus transgressed the Right Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Venus transgressed the Right Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵與偽漢兵大戰於鄱陽湖，陳友諒敗績而死。

translations.literal: That month, Ming troops and the troops of the false Han fought a great battle at Poyang Lake; Chen Youliang suffered defeat and died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming and false Han armies fought a great battle on Poyang Lake; Chen Youliang was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 其子理自立，仍據武昌為都，改元德壽，大明兵遂進圍武昌。

translations.literal: His son Li established himself as ruler, still holding Wuchang as capital, changed the era name to Deshou, and Ming troops thereupon advanced to besiege Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: His son Li declared himself ruler, kept Wuchang as his capital, and adopted the era name Deshou; Ming forces then advanced to besiege the city.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯朔，遣爪哇使淡蒙加加殿還國，詔賜其國主三珠金虎符及織金紋幣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingmao new moon; the Javanese envoy Tanmeng Jiajiadian was dispatched to return to his country; an edict granted his ruler a three-pearl golden tiger tally and brocaded silks with gold patterns.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of dingmao, the Javanese envoy Tanmeng Jiajiadian was sent home with an edict granting his ruler a three-pearl golden tiger tally and brocaded silks with gold patterns.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Venus transgressed the Left Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Venus transgressed the Left Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，辰星犯填星，丁亥，太白犯填星。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Mercury transgressed Saturn; on dinghai day, Venus transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Mercury transgressed Saturn; on the dinghai day Venus transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯亢宿。

translations.literal: Mercury transgressed the Neck asterism.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury encroached upon the Neck asterism.

sentences.zh: 是月，張士誠自稱吳王，來請命，不報。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Shicheng styled himself King of Wu and came to request appointment; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Shicheng declared himself King of Wu and petitioned for official recognition, but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 遣戶部侍郎博羅帖木兒等征海運於張士誠，士誠不與。

translations.literal: Boluo Temür, vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue, and others were dispatched to levy sea-transport grain from Zhang Shicheng; Shicheng would not provide it.
translations.idiomatic: Boluo Temür, vice minister of revenue, and others were sent to collect sea-transport grain from Zhang Shicheng, but he refused to supply it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申朔，青齊一方赤氣千里。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen new moon; over Qing and Qi a crimson vapor stretched for a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the new moon of bingshen in the tenth month, a crimson vapor a thousand li long covered Qing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Venus transgressed the Root asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Venus transgressed the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，湖廣偽姚平章、張知院陰遣人言於擴廓帖木兒，設計擒殺偽漢主陳理及偽夏主明玉珍，不果。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the false chief minister Yao of Huguang and Director Zhang secretly sent men to speak with Köke Temür, plotting to capture and kill the false Han ruler Chen Li and the false Xia ruler Ming Yuzhen; it did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the false chief minister Yao of Huguang and Director Zhang secretly sent envoys to Köke Temür with a plan to capture and kill the false Han ruler Chen Li and the false Xia ruler Ming Yuzhen, but the plot failed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，監察御史米只兒海牙劾奏太傅太平罪狀，詔安置太平於陜西之西，仍拘收宣命並禦賜等物。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, investigating censor Mizhi Haiya impeached Grand Preceptor Taiping for his crimes; an edict ordered Taiping placed under surveillance in western Shaanxi and his appointment patents and imperial gifts and other items seized.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, investigating censor Mizhi Haiya impeached Grand Preceptor Taiping; an edict confined him to western Shaanxi and ordered his appointment patents and imperial gifts seized.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白犯房宿。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Venus transgressed the Room asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Venus transgressed the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 是月，擴廓帖木兒遣僉樞密院事任亮復安陸府。

translations.literal: That month, Köke Temür dispatched Ren Liang, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to recover Anlu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Köke Temür sent Ren Liang, associate director of the bureau of military affairs, to recover Anlu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒遣兵攻冀寧，至石嶺關，擴廓帖木兒大破走之，擒其將烏馬兒、殷興祖。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür dispatched troops to attack Jining and reached Shiling Pass; Köke Temür utterly defeated them and drove them off, capturing his generals Umar and Yin Xingzu.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür sent troops to attack Jining and reached Shiling Pass, but Köke Temür routed them and captured his generals Umar and Yin Xingzu.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒軍由是不振。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür's army from this was no longer vigorous.
translations.idiomatic: From this point Bolad Temür's army never recovered its strength.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，御史臺臣言：「故右丞相脫脫有大臣之體，向在中書，政務修舉，深懼滿盈，自求引退，加封鄭王，固辭不受。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renshen day; censorate officials said: "The late right chief minister Toqto'a had the bearing of a great minister; while at the Secretariat, government affairs were well ordered; deeply fearing excess, he sought withdrawal on his own; he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng but firmly declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renshen day, censorate officials said: "The late right chief minister Toqto'a had the bearing of a great minister; while at the Secretariat he kept government in good order, and when he feared excess he asked to retire on his own; he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng but firmly declined."

sentences.zh: 再秉鈞軸，克濟艱危，統軍進征，平徐州，收六合，大功垂成，浮言構難，奉詔謝兵，就貶以沒。

translations.literal: Again holding the helm of state, he overcame grave peril; commanding armies in advance campaigns, he pacified Xuzhou and recovered Luhe; great merit was nearly complete when idle talk stirred trouble; obeying an edict he relinquished his troops and, upon demotion, died.
translations.idiomatic: When he again held the helm of state he overcame grave crises, commanded armies in the field, pacified Xuzhou, and recovered Luhe; his great achievement was nearly complete when slander stirred trouble, and after obeying an edict to relinquish his troops he died in exile.

sentences.zh: 已蒙錄用其子，還所籍田宅，更乞憫其勛舊，還其所授宣命。

translations.literal: His son has already been enrolled in office, and the confiscated fields and dwellings have been returned; we further beg compassion for his meritorious service and the return of the appointment patents he was granted.
translations.idiomatic: His son has already been restored to office and his confiscated lands and houses returned; we further ask that his past service be honored and his appointment patents restored.

sentences.zh: 」從之。
