translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太陰犯軒轅，歲星犯左執法。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the moon transgressed the Chariot asterism, and Jupiter transgressed the Left Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the moon transgressed the Chariot asterism and Jupiter transgressed the Left Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 是歲，御史大夫老的沙與知樞密院事禿堅帖木兒，得罪於皇太子，皆奔大同，孛羅帖木兒匿之營中。

translations.literal: That year, censor-in-chief Laodisha and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Tuγ Temür offended the heir apparent; both fled to Datong, and Bolad Temür hid them in his camp.
translations.idiomatic: That year censor-in-chief Laodisha and bureau director Tuγ Temür offended the heir apparent; both fled to Datong, and Bolad Temür sheltered them in his camp.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月戊寅，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, wuyin day; the moon transgressed the Chariot asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on the wuyin day of the first month of spring, the moon transgressed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，保德州民家產豬一頭兩身。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, in a commoner's household in Baode Prefecture a pig was born with one head and two bodies.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, a pig with one head and two bodies was born in a commoner's household in Baode prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: Second month, renzi day; Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renzi day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯西咸池。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the moon transgressed the Western Shared Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the moon transgressed the Western Shared Pool.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明滅偽漢，其所據湖南北、江西諸郡皆降於大明。

translations.literal: That month, the Ming destroyed the false Han; the various prefectures of Hunan, Hubei, and Jiangxi that it had held all surrendered to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Ming destroyed the false Han, and the Hunan, Hubei, and Jiangxi prefectures it had held all surrendered to them.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，監察御史王朵列禿、崔卜顏帖木兒等諫皇太子勿親征。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai day; investigating censors Wang Duolietu, Cui Buyan Temür, and others remonstrated with the heir apparent not to campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yihai day, investigating censors Wang Duolietu, Cui Buyan Temür, and others urged the heir apparent not to take the field in person.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔以孛羅帖木兒匿老的沙，謀為悖逆，解其兵權，削其官爵，候道路開通，許還四川田里。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, an edict charged that Bolad Temür had hidden Laodisha and plotted rebellion; his military authority was removed and his offices and ranks stripped; when the roads were open, he was permitted to return to his fields and dwellings in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict charged Bolad Temür with hiding Laodisha and plotting rebellion, stripped him of military command and rank, and allowed him to return to his lands in Sichuan once the roads were open.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒拒命不受。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür refused the order and would not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür refused the order.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午朔，命擴廓帖木兒討孛羅帖木兒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiawu new moon; Köke Temür was ordered to campaign against Bolad Temür.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the new moon of jiawu in the fourth month, Köke Temür was ordered to campaign against Bolad Temür.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯西咸池。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Western Shared Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Western Shared Pool.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒悉知詔令調遣之事非出帝意，皆右丞相搠思監所為，遂令禿堅帖木兒舉兵向闕。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür fully understood that the edicts and orders for troop deployments did not come from the emperor's intent but were all the doing of right chief minister Suosijian; he therefore ordered Tuγ Temür to raise troops and march on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür knew that the edicts ordering troop movements did not come from the emperor but from right chief minister Suosijian, so he ordered Tuγ Temür to raise troops and march on the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禿堅帖木兒兵入居庸關。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Tuγ Temür's troops entered Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Tuγ Temür's troops entered Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，知樞密院事也速、詹事不蘭奚迎戰於皇后店。

translations.literal: On guimao day, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yesu and household director Bulanxi met them in battle at Empress's Inn.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, bureau director Yesu and household director Bulanxi met them in battle at Empress's Inn.

sentences.zh: 不蘭奚力戰，也速不援而退，不蘭奚幾為所獲，脫身東走。

translations.literal: Bulanxi fought fiercely; Yesu did not reinforce him and withdrew; Bulanxi was nearly captured, but escaped and fled east.
translations.idiomatic: Bulanxi fought hard, but Yesu failed to reinforce him and withdrew; Bulanxi was nearly captured before he broke free and fled east.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，皇太子率侍衛兵出光熙門，東走古北口，趨興、松。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the heir apparent led the guard troops out through Guangxi Gate, fled east toward Gubeikou, and hastened toward Xing and Song.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the heir apparent led the guard troops out through Guangxi Gate, fled east toward Gubeikou, and headed for Xing and Song.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禿堅帖木兒兵至清河列營。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Tuγ Temür's troops reached Qinghe and set up camp.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Tuγ Temür's troops reached Qinghe and encamped.

sentences.zh: 時都城無備，城中大震，令百官吏卒分守京城，使達達國師至其軍問故，以必得搠思監及宦官樸不花為對，詔慰解之，不聽。

translations.literal: At the time the capital was unprepared, and the city was greatly shaken; officials, clerks, and soldiers were ordered to divide and guard the capital; a Dada state preceptor was sent to his army to ask the reason; the reply was that Suosijian and the eunuch Puhua must be obtained; an edict sought to soothe and resolve the matter, but he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was unprepared and the city was in uproar; officials and soldiers were ordered to man the defenses; a Dada state preceptor was sent to ask why he had marched, and the answer was that Suosijian and the eunuch Puhua must be handed over; an edict tried to soothe him, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔屏搠思監於嶺北，竄樸不花於甘肅，執而與之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, an edict ordered Suosijian banished to Lingbei and Puhua sent into exile in Gansu; they were seized and handed over to him.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, an edict banished Suosijian to Lingbei and sent Puhua into exile in Gansu; both were seized and handed over to him.

sentences.zh: 復孛羅帖木兒前官，仍總兵。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür's former offices were restored, and he still held overall command of the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür's former offices were restored and he retained overall military command.

sentences.zh: 以也速為左丞相。

translations.literal: Yesu was made left chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yesu was appointed left chief minister.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禿堅帖木兒陳兵自健德門入，覲帝於延春閣，慟哭請罪，帝就宴賚之。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Tuγ Temür displayed his troops and entered through Jiande Gate; he had an audience with the emperor at Yanchun Pavilion, wept bitterly and begged forgiveness, and the emperor thereupon feasted and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Tuγ Temür marched his troops in through Jiande Gate, had an audience with the emperor at Yanchun Pavilion, wept and begged forgiveness, and the emperor then feasted and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 加孛羅帖木兒太保，依前守禦大同，禿堅帖木兒為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür was promoted to grand guardian and, as before, defended Datong; Tuγ Temür was made Secretariat chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür was promoted to grand guardian and continued to defend Datong; Tuγ Temür was appointed Secretariat chief minister.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，禿堅帖木兒軍還。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Tuγ Temür's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Tuγ Temür's army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇太子至路兒嶺。

translations.literal: The heir apparent reached Luliling.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent arrived at Luliling.

sentences.zh: 詔追及之，還宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that he be overtaken and brought back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him overtaken and brought back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Venus transgressed the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Venus transgressed the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子朔，黃河清。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiazi new moon; the Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of jiazi, the Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，擴廓帖木兒奉命討孛羅帖木兒，屯兵冀寧，其東道以白鎖住領兵三萬，守禦京師，中道以貊高、竹貞領兵四萬，西道以關保領軍五萬，合擊之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Köke Temür, ordered to campaign against Bolad Temür, stationed troops at Jining; on the eastern route Suochu led thirty thousand troops to defend the capital; on the central route Mo Gao and Zhuzhen led forty thousand troops; on the western route Guan Bao led fifty thousand troops; they were to join in a combined attack.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Köke Temür, ordered to campaign against Bolad Temür, encamped at Jining; Suochu led thirty thousand troops on the eastern route to defend the capital, Mo Gao and Zhuzhen forty thousand on the central route, and Guan Bao fifty thousand on the western route for a combined attack.

sentences.zh: 關保等兵逼大同，孛羅帖木兒留兵守大同，而自率兵與禿堅帖木兒、老的沙復大舉向闕。

translations.literal: Guan Bao and the others pressed toward Datong; Bolad Temür left troops to defend Datong and himself led troops with Tuγ Temür and Laodisha in another great advance on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao and the others pressed toward Datong; Bolad Temür left troops to hold the city and marched again on the capital with Tuγ Temür and Laodisha.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Venus transgressed the Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Venus transgressed the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，又犯積屍氣，歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yihai day, it again transgressed the corpse-gas; Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Venus again transgressed the corpse-gas, and Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，三星晝見，白氣橫突其中。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guimao day; three stars were visible in daylight, and white vapor cut across among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guimao day, three stars were visible by day with white vapor cutting across them.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，河南府有大星夜見南方，光如晝。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, in Henan Prefecture a great star appeared at night in the south, its light like daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, a great star appeared at night in the south over Henan prefecture, bright as daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大星隕，照夜如晝，及旦，黑氣晦暗如夜。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, a great star fell; it illuminated the night like daylight; by dawn black vapor made the darkness like night.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, a great meteor fell and lit the night like day; by dawn black vapor made the sky as dark as night again.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，白鎖住以兵至京師，請皇太子西行。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Suochu arrived at the capital with troops and requested that the heir apparent go west.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Suochu arrived at the capital with troops and asked the heir apparent to go west.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Venus transgressed the Right Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Venus transgressed the Right Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 是月，保德州黃龍見井中。

translations.literal: That month, in Baode Prefecture a yellow dragon was seen in a well.
translations.idiomatic: That month a yellow dragon was seen in a well in Baode prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，太白與歲星合於翼宿。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, guihai day; Venus and Jupiter converged in the Wing asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the guihai day of the seventh month, Venus and Jupiter converged in the Wing asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲子，歲星犯左執法。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Jupiter transgressed the Left Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Jupiter transgressed the Left Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，孛羅帖木兒前鋒軍入居庸關，皇太子親率軍禦於清河，也速軍於昌平，軍士皆無鬥志。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Bolad Temür's vanguard entered Juyong Pass; the heir apparent personally led troops to resist at Qinghe; Yesu's army was at Changping; the soldiers all lacked fighting spirit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Bolad Temür's vanguard entered Juyong Pass; the heir apparent personally led troops to resist at Qinghe while Yesu encamped at Changping, but the soldiers had no will to fight.

sentences.zh: 皇太子馳還都城，白鎖住引兵入平則門。

translations.literal: The heir apparent galloped back to the capital; Suochu led troops in through Pingze Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent galloped back to the capital as Suochu led his troops in through Pingze Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，白鎖住扈從皇太子出順承門，由雄、霸、河間，取道往冀寧。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Suochu escorted the heir apparent out through Shuncheng Gate; by way of Xiong, Ba, and Hejian they took the route toward Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Suochu escorted the heir apparent out through Shuncheng Gate and set out toward Jining by way of Xiong, Ba, and Hejian.

sentences.zh: 戊子，孛羅帖木兒駐兵健德門外，與禿堅帖木兒、老的沙入見帝於宣文閣，訴其非罪，皆泣，帝亦泣，乃賜宴。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Bolad Temür stationed troops outside Jiande Gate; with Tuγ Temür and Laodisha he entered to have an audience with the emperor at Xuanwen Pavilion, pleading that he was not guilty; all wept, the emperor also wept, and then a feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Bolad Temür encamped outside Jiande Gate; he entered with Tuγ Temür and Laodisha to see the emperor at Xuanwen Pavilion and pleaded his innocence; all wept, the emperor wept too, and then a feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒欲追襲皇太子，老的沙止之。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür wished to pursue and attack the heir apparent; Laodisha stopped him.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür wanted to pursue the heir apparent, but Laodisha stopped him.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔以孛羅帖木兒為中書左丞相，老的沙為中書平章政事，禿堅帖木兒為御史大夫，其部屬布列省臺百司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an edict made Bolad Temür left chief minister of the Secretariat, Laodisha Secretariat chief minister, and Tuγ Temür censor-in-chief; their subordinates were distributed through the provincial offices, censorate, and hundred bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict made Bolad Temür left chief minister of the Secretariat, Laodisha Secretariat chief minister, and Tuγ Temür censor-in-chief, and placed their followers throughout the provincial offices, censorate, and central bureaus.

sentences.zh: 以也速知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Yesu was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yesu was appointed director of the bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔諭：「孛羅帖木兒、擴廓帖木兒俱朕股肱，視同心膂，自今各棄宿忿，弼成大勛。

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed: "Bolad Temür and Köke Temür are both my arms and thighs; regard them as one heart and one backbone; from now on each shall abandon old resentments and assist in achieving great merit."
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed: "Bolad Temür and Köke Temür are both my trusted ministers; treat them as one heart and one will; from now on put aside old grievances and together achieve great deeds."

sentences.zh: 」是月，大明兵取廬州路。

translations.literal: " That month, Ming troops captured Luzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Luzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renchen new moon; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of renchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙未，熒惑犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Mars transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Mars transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔以孛羅帖木兒為中書右丞相、監修國史，節制天下軍馬。

translations.literal: On renyin day, an edict made Bolad Temür right chief minister of the Secretariat, supervisor of the compilation of the national history, with overall command of all armies and horses under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict appointed Bolad Temür right chief minister of the Secretariat, supervisor of the national history, and commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太子至冀寧。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the heir apparent reached Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the heir apparent reached Jining.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，張士誠自以其弟士信代達識帖睦邇為江浙行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Zhang Shicheng on his own authority had his younger brother Shixin replace Darmashiri as left chief minister of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Zhang Shicheng installed his younger brother Shixin as left chief minister of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat in place of Darmashiri.

sentences.zh: 是月，孛羅帖木兒請誅狎臣禿魯帖木兒、波迪哇兒祃，罷三宮不急造作，沙汰宦官，減省錢糧，禁止西番僧人好事。

translations.literal: That month, Bolad Temür requested execution of favorite ministers Tolui Temür and Bodi Warmaq, abolition of non-urgent construction projects in the three palaces, purging of eunuchs, reduction of expenses for funds and grain, and prohibition of Tibetan monks' meddling.
translations.idiomatic: That month Bolad Temür called for the execution of the favorites Tolui Temür and Bodi Warmaq, an end to nonessential palace construction, a purge of eunuchs, cuts in fiscal spending, and a ban on Tibetan monks' interference in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉朔，宦官思龍宜潛送宮女伯忽都出自順承門，以達於皇太子。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinyou new moon; eunuch Silongyi secretly sent palace woman Boroγdu out through the Shuncheng Gate to reach the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of xinyou, the eunuch Silongyi secretly sent the palace woman Boroγdu out through the Shuncheng Gate to join the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，夜，天西北有紅光，至東而散。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, at night, in the northwest of Heaven there was a red glow that reached the east and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, a red glow appeared in the northwest sky at night, stretched eastward, and then dispersed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Triaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Triaster.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取中興及歸、峽、潭、衡等路。

translations.literal: That month, Ming troops took Zhongxing and the circuits of Gui, Xia, Tan, and Heng, among others.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Zhongxing and the circuits of Gui, Xia, Tan, and Heng.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingwu day; the moon transgressed the Net constellation.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the bingwu day of the tenth month, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔皇太子還京師。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, an edict ordered the heir apparent to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, an edict ordered the heir apparent to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 命也速、老的沙分道總兵。

translations.literal: Yesu and Laodisha were ordered to take overall command of troops by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Yesu and Laodisha were ordered to divide their forces and take overall command.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，太陰犯太白。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yimao day; the moon transgressed Venus.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yimao day, the moon transgressed Venus.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月癸亥，封李思齊為許國公。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, guihai day; Li Siqi was enfeoffed as Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, on the guihai day of the first month of spring, Li Siqi was enfeoffed as Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，亦如之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the same occurred.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大明兵取寶慶路，守將唐隆道遁走。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Ming troops took Baoqing Circuit; defending general Tang Longdao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Ming forces captured Baoqing circuit; the defending general Tang Longdao fled.

sentences.zh: 偽漢守將熊天瑞以贛州及韶州、南雄降於大明。

translations.literal: The false Han defending general Xiong Tianrui surrendered Ganzhou, Shaozhou, Nanxiong, and other places to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Tianrui, a false Han commander, surrendered Ganzhou, Shaozhou, and Nanxiong to Ming.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白犯建星。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Venus transgressed the Establishment asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Venus transgressed the Establishment asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬午，監察御史孛羅帖木兒、賈彬等辯明哈麻、雪雪之罪。

translations.literal: On renwu day, investigating censors Bolad Temür, Jia Bin, and others clarified the crimes of Bayan Temür and Xuexue.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, investigating censors Bolad Temür, Jia Bin, and others established the guilt of Bayan Temür and Xuexue.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，汴梁路見日傍有一月一星。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day; at Bianliang Circuit, beside the sun was seen one moon and one star.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinchou day, a moon and a star were seen beside the sun at Bianliang circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 戊午，皇太子在冀寧，命甘肅行省平章政事朵兒只班以岐王阿剌乞兒軍馬，會平章政事臧卜、李思齊，各以兵守寧夏。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the heir apparent being at Jining, he ordered Gansu Branch Secretariat chief minister Dorjiban to take the Prince of Qi Alaqer's army and horses, join chief ministers Zangbu and Li Siqi, and each with troops guard Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, with the heir apparent at Jining, he ordered Dorjiban, chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat, to take Prince Alaqer of Qi's forces, join chief ministers Zangbu and Li Siqi, and hold Ningxia with their combined armies.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，皇太子下令於擴廓帖木兒軍中曰：「孛羅帖木兒襲據京師，余既受命總督天下諸軍，恭行顯罰，少保、中書平章政事擴廓帖木兒，躬勒將士，分道進兵，諸王、駙馬及陜西平章政事李思齊等，各統軍馬，尚其奮義戮力，克期恢復。

translations.literal: Third month, gengshen day; the heir apparent issued orders within Köke Temür's camp, saying: "Bolad Temür has seized and held the capital. I have already received the mandate to take overall command of all armies under Heaven and reverently carry out manifest punishment. Junior Guardian and Secretariat chief minister Köke Temür personally leads generals and soldiers, advancing by separate routes; princes, imperial sons-in-law, and Shaanxi chief minister Li Siqi and others each command armies and horses — may they rouse righteous zeal and join in slaughter, and on the fixed date recover [the capital]."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengshen day, the heir apparent issued orders to Köke Temür's army: "Bolad Temür has seized the capital. Having received the mandate to command all armies under Heaven, I mean to carry out righteous punishment. Junior Guardian and Secretariat chief minister Köke Temür is personally leading the troops in a multi-pronged advance; princes, imperial sons-in-law, and Shaanxi chief minister Li Siqi and others each command their own forces. I look to their zeal in this righteous cause and their united effort to recover the capital on schedule."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，孛羅帖木兒幽置皇后奇氏於諸色總管府。

translations.literal: " On bingyin day, Bolad Temür secretly detained Empress Gi at the Directorate of Miscellaneous Crafts.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Bolad Temür secretly imprisoned Empress Gi at the Directorate of Miscellaneous Crafts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命老的沙、別帖木兒並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Laodisha and Bet Temür were both made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Laodisha and Bet Temür were both appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Venus transgressed the Encampment asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Venus transgressed the Encampment asterism.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，孛羅帖木兒至諸色總管府見皇后奇氏，令還宮取印章，作書遺皇太子，遣內侍官完者禿持往冀寧，復出皇后，幽之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengyin day; Bolad Temür went to the Directorate of Miscellaneous Crafts to see Empress Gi, ordered her to return to the palace to fetch seals, composed a letter to leave for the heir apparent, dispatched inner service official Qanji Tu to take it to Jining, brought the empress out again, and secretly detained her.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the gengyin day of the fourth month, Bolad Temür went to the Directorate of Miscellaneous Crafts to see Empress Gi, sent her back to the palace for the imperial seals, wrote a letter to the heir apparent, and had the inner attendant Qanji Tu carry it to Jining; he then brought the empress out again and reimprisoned her.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，關保等兵進圍大同。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Guan Bao and others' troops advanced to besiege Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Guan Bao and his army advanced to besiege Datong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，熒惑犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Mars transgressed the Administrative Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Mars transgressed the Administrative Star.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，關保入大同。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Guan Bao entered Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Guan Bao entered Datong.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，熒惑犯太微垣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinyou day; Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinyou day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲子，京師天雨氂，長尺許，或言於帝曰：「龍絲也。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, at the capital Heaven rained qi-fibers more than a foot long; someone said to the emperor: "It is dragon silk."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, fibers more than a foot long fell from the sky over the capital; someone told the emperor, "It is dragon silk."

sentences.zh: 」命拾而祀之。

translations.literal: " He ordered them gathered and used in sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered them collected and offered in sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，大明兵破安陸府，守將任亮迎戰，被執。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Ming troops stormed Anlu Prefecture; defending general Ren Liang went out to give battle and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Ming forces stormed Anlu prefecture; the defending general Ren Liang met them in battle and was captured.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大明兵破襄陽路。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Ming troops stormed Xiangyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Ming forces captured Xiangyang circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，侯卜延答失奉威順王自雲南經蜀轉戰而出，至成州，欲之京師，李思齊俾屯田於成州。

translations.literal: That month, Qobuγyan Dash escorted the Weishun Prince out from Yunnan through Shu, fighting in transit, reaching Chenzhou; wishing to go to the capital, Li Siqi had him garrison-farm at Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qobuγyan Dash led the Prince of Weishun out of Yunnan through Sichuan after hard fighting and reached Chenzhou; when he wished to continue to the capital, Li Siqi had him settle into garrison farming at Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子朔，以黎安道為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuzi new moon; Li Andao was made associate chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of wuzi, Li Andao was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，湖廣行省左丞周文貴復寶慶路。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, left vice director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat Zhou Wengui recovered Baoqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, left vice director Zhou Wengui of the Huguang branch secretariat recovered Baoqing circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇后奇氏自幽所還宮。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Empress Gi returned to the palace from secret detention.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Empress Gi returned to the palace from confinement.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以太尉火你赤為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Grand Preceptor Huonichi was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Grand Preceptor Huonichi was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 是月，皇太子加李思齊銀青榮祿大夫、邠國公、中書平章政事、皇太子詹事，兼四川行樞密院事、虎符招討使。

translations.literal: That month, the heir apparent promoted Li Siqi to grand master for splendid happiness with silver seal, Duke of Bin, Secretariat chief minister, director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, concurrently director of the Sichuan Branch Bureau of Military Affairs and tiger-tally pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That month the heir apparent promoted Li Siqi to grand master for splendid happiness with silver seal, Duke of Bin, Secretariat chief minister, and director of the heir apparent's household, with concurrent charge of the Sichuan branch bureau of military affairs and the rank of tiger-tally pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 分中書四部。

translations.literal: The Secretariat was divided into four departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was reorganized into four departments.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，填星、歲星、熒惑聚於角、亢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingchou day; Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars gathered at the Horn and Neck asterisms.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the dingchou day of the seventh month, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars gathered at the Horn and Neck asterisms.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，孛羅帖木兒伏誅，禿堅帖木兒、老的沙皆遁走。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Bolad Temür was executed by decapitation in hiding; Tuγ Temür and Laodisha both fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Bolad Temür was executed; Tuγ Temür and Laodisha both fled.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣使函孛羅帖木兒首往冀寧，召皇太子還京師。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, envoys were dispatched bearing Bolad Temür's head in a casket to Jining, summoning the heir apparent to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, envoys bearing Bolad Temür's head in a box were sent to Jining to summon the heir apparent back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: All under Heaven received a great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 黎安道、方脫脫、雷一聲皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Li Andao, Fang Toto, and Lei Yisheng were all executed by decapitation in hiding.
translations.idiomatic: Li Andao, Fang Toto, and Lei Yisheng were all executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，京師大水。

translations.literal: That month, the capital suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital was struck by severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 河決小流口，達於清河。

translations.literal: The river breached at Xiaoliukou and reached Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke through at Xiaoliukou and flowed into the Qing River.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥朔，京城門至是不開者三日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dinghai new moon; from this point the capital's gates were not opened for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of dinghai, the capital's gates remained closed for three days.

sentences.zh: 竹貞、貊高軍至城外，命軍士緣城而上，碎平則門鍵，悉以軍入，占民居，奪民財。

translations.literal: Zhuzhen and Mo Gao's army reached outside the walls; they ordered soldiers to climb the wall, smashed the lock of the Pingze Gate, brought the entire army in, seized civilians' dwellings, and took civilian property.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuzhen and Mo Gao's army reached the walls, had soldiers scale them, broke the lock of the Pingze Gate, poured the army into the city, occupied civilian homes, and seized their property.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Establishment asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Establishment asterism.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon transgressed the Encampment asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the moon transgressed the Encampment asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔命皇太子分調將帥，戡定未復郡邑，即還京師，行事之際，承制用人，並準正授。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict ordered the heir apparent to assign generals and commanders separately, pacify counties and districts not yet recovered, then immediately return to the capital; in the course of action, to appoint personnel by provisional edict, all counted as regular appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict ordered the heir apparent to deploy generals separately, pacify counties and districts still unreclaimed, then return promptly to the capital; while acting he was empowered to make appointments by provisional commission, all to count as regular appointments.

sentences.zh: 丁未，皇后弘吉剌氏崩。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the empress of the Qongγirad clan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the Qongγirad empress died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以洪寶寶、帖古思不花、捏烈禿並為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Hong Baobao, Tegus Buqa, and Niryetu were all made Secretariat chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Hong Baobao, Tegus Buqa, and Niryetu were all appointed Secretariat chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 九月，擴廓帖木兒扈從皇太子至京師。

translations.literal: Ninth month; Köke Temür escorted the heir apparent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Köke Temür escorted the heir apparent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔以伯撒裏為太師、中書右丞相、監修國史；

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict made Barsakiri grand preceptor, right chief minister of the Secretariat, and supervisor of the compilation of the national history;
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict appointed Barsakiri grand preceptor, right chief minister of the Secretariat, and supervisor of the national history;

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒為太尉、中書左丞相、錄軍國重事、同監修國史、知樞密院事，兼太子詹事。

translations.literal: Köke Temür was made grand preceptor of state, left chief minister of the Secretariat, recorder of weighty matters of army and state, joint supervisor of the national history, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, concurrently director of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temür was appointed grand preceptor of state, left chief minister of the Secretariat, recorder of weighty military and state affairs, joint supervisor of the national history, director of the bureau of military affairs, and concurrently director of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 是月，以方國珍為淮南行省左丞相，分省慶元。

translations.literal: That month, Fang Guozhen was made left chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat, with a branch secretariat at Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fang Guozhen was appointed left chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, with a branch administration at Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，熒惑犯天江。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinmao day; Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the xinmao day of the tenth month, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以哈剌章為知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Hala Zhang was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Hala Zhang was appointed director of the bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，益王渾都帖木兒、樞密副使觀音奴擒老的沙，誅之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Prince of Yi Qunqu Temür and vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Guanyinnu captured Laodisha and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Prince Qunqu Temür of Yi and bureau vice director Guanyinnu captured Laodisha and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 禿堅帖木兒以余兵往八兒思之地，命嶺北行省左丞相山僧及知樞密院事魏賽因不花同討之。

translations.literal: Tuγ Temür with remaining troops went to the lands of Baris; the left chief minister of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat Shanseng and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Wei Sayin Buqa were ordered jointly to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Tuγ Temür fled with his remaining troops toward Baris; left chief minister Shanseng of the Lingbei branch secretariat and bureau director Wei Sayin Buqa were ordered to pursue him jointly.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以資政院使禿魯為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Tolui, commissioner of the Zizheng Court, was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Tolui, commissioner of the Zizheng Court, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，熒惑犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Mars transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Mars transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Right Enforcer constellation.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，以賓國公五十八為知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengshen day; Duke of Bin Wushiba was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the gengshen day, Duke Wushiba of Bin was appointed director of the bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔張良弼、俞寶、孔興等悉聽調於擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhang Liangbi, Yu Bao, Kong Xing, and others all to accept transfer under Köke Temür's command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed Zhang Liangbi, Yu Bao, Kong Xing, and others under Köke Temür's command.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白、辰星、熒惑聚於斗宿。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Venus, Mercury, and Mars gathered at the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Venus, Mercury, and Mars gathered at the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Net constellation.
translations.idiomatic: The moon passed through the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔封擴廓帖木兒河南王，代皇太子親征，總制關陜、晉冀、山東等處並迤南一應軍馬，諸王各愛馬應該總兵、統兵、領兵等官，凡軍民一切機務、錢糧、名爵、黜陟、予奪，悉聽便宜行事。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, an edict enfeoffed Köke Temür as King of Henan, to replace the heir apparent in personally campaigning, with overall command of Guanxi-Shaanxi, Jin-Ji, Shandong, and other regions together with all armies southward; princes, favored horses, and all officials who should command armies in overall, unified, or leading capacities — for all military and civilian affairs, funds and grain, titles and ranks, dismissals and promotions, grants and seizures, he was entirely to act as he saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, an edict enfeoffed Köke Temür as King of Henan, deputized him to lead the campaign in the heir apparent's place, and placed under his overall command the armies of Shaanxi, Shanxi-Hebei, Shandong, and all territories to the south; princes, imperial favorites, and every officer with command over troops were subordinated to him in all military and civilian affairs — funds, grain, titles, appointments, and dismissals — with full discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白犯辰星。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Venus transgressed Mercury.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Venus transgressed Mercury.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以脫脫木兒為中書右丞，達識帖木兒為參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Totoγ Temür was made right vice director of the Secretariat, and Darmashiri Temür was made associate chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Totoγ Temür was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat, and Darmashiri Temür was appointed associate chief minister.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，太白犯熒惑，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jichou day; Venus transgressed Mars, and the moon transgressed the Encampment asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jichou day, Venus transgressed Mars and the moon transgressed the Encampment asterism.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取泰州。

translations.literal: That month, Ming troops took Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 時泰州、通州、高郵、淮安、徐州、宿州、泗州、濠州、安豐諸郡，皆張士誠所據。

translations.literal: At the time the prefectures of Taizhou, Tongzhou, Gaoyou, Huai'an, Xuzhou, Suzhou, Sizhou, Haozhou, and Anfeng were all held by Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Taizhou, Tongzhou, Gaoyou, Huai'an, Xuzhou, Suzhou, Sizhou, Haozhou, and Anfeng were all held by Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，詔立次皇后奇氏為皇后，改奇氏為肅良合氏，詔天下，仍封奇氏父以上三世皆為王爵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yimao day; an edict established secondary empress Gi as empress, changed the Gi clan name to the Sulaiγalt Clan, proclaimed it to all under Heaven, and still enfeoffed the fathers of Empress Gi for three generations as kings.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yimao day, an edict elevated secondary empress Gi to empress, changed her clan name to Sulaiγalt, proclaimed this throughout the realm, and enfeoffed her father and two prior generations as royalty.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the moon transgressed the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 以帖林沙為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Tielinsha was made associate chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Tielinsha was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，歲星掩房宿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Jupiter occulted the Room asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Jupiter occulted the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 是月，禿堅帖木兒伏誅。

translations.literal: That month, Tuγ Temür was executed by decapitation in hiding.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tuγ Temür was executed.
